Astrolabe (Ceremony): Prerequisite: Survival: Navigation[2]. If you get lost while navigating and identify that you are lost, you may use an Astrolabe to re-roll your Navigation Check for this Travel Ledger. When you re-roll this check, you may choose to keep the original or new roll. You may do this once per journey.

1 Item Slot · 60gc · Navigation Tools, rulebook p.204
